subthemes.name: Sustained attention
items: I find it hard to pay attention for a whole lesson.
I zone out during class and miss what the teacher said.
I can only focus for a short time before my mind wanders.
I lose my place when I'm reading.
I need to re-read things many times to understand them.
I space out even in lessons I like.
I find it hard to sit through a long task.
My attention feels like it keeps slipping away.

subthemes.name: Selective attention
items: I notice every small sound around me when I study.
I can't tune out people talking nearby when I need to focus.
I get pulled by things happening outside my study space.
I find background noise distracting even when it's quiet to others.
I can't pick out the important part of what my teacher is saying.
My eyes keep jumping around when I should be looking at one thing.
I notice movement in the room and lose track of what I was doing.
Even small things pull my attention away.

subthemes.name: Working memory
items: I forget instructions right after my teacher tells me.
I lose track of what I was going to say.
I forget what I came into a room to do.
I can't remember the first part of the question by the time I get to the end.
I need instructions written down or I'll forget them.
I forget steps in my own plan while I'm doing it.
Numbers or facts slip out of my head quickly.

subthemes.name: Cognitive fatigue
items: I feel mentally tired after a short time of study.
My brain feels foggy by the middle of the day.
I feel wiped out after one hour of homework.
Focus gets harder as the day goes on.
I feel more tired reading than doing physical activity.
I need lots of breaks just to keep going.
By evening, I can't focus on study at all.

subthemes.name: Task initiation
items: I take a long time to actually start my homework.
I open my book and just stare at it.
I keep putting off starting even when I know I should.
I feel stuck at the beginning of tasks.
I need someone to remind me again and again to start.
I find other things to do instead of starting the real task.
Starting feels like the hardest part.
Even an easy task feels hard to begin.

subthemes.name: First-step paralysis
items: I don't know where to begin with my homework.
I feel frozen when I look at a big task.
I feel confused about what step to take first.
I can't break my homework into smaller pieces.
I feel scared I'll do the first step wrong.
I need an adult to tell me exactly how to start.
I keep re-reading the task instead of starting it.
My mind goes blank when I need to begin.

subthemes.name: Mental warm-up
items: I need a long time to settle into a task before I can focus.
I can't 'switch on' my study brain quickly.
I take ages to find my groove even after I've started.
I feel slow at the start of every study session.
I need to scroll or chat before I can begin studying.
I feel sleepy or fuzzy when I sit down to start.
The first 15 minutes of study are the hardest.

subthemes.name: Transition difficulty
items: I find it hard to switch from play to study.
I get annoyed when I'm asked to stop one activity to start another.
I keep thinking about the thing I just stopped doing.
I need extra time to adjust to a new task.
I lose focus when I switch between subjects.
Going from screen time to study takes me a long time.
I need a 'buffer' between activities to feel okay.

subthemes.name: External distractions
items: My phone keeps pulling me away from my work.
I check my phone every few minutes while studying.
Notifications on my devices break my focus.
TV or music in the background distracts me.
I can't resist opening YouTube, games or chat while I should be working.
My siblings or family moving around breaks my focus.
I get distracted by things on my study table.
Even small sounds or movements pull me away.

subthemes.name: Internal distractions
items: My own thoughts take me away from the task.
I start daydreaming when I should be studying.
I think about plans, games or shows during study.
I remember other things I want to do while I'm working.
I feel restless and have to get up often.
My mind jumps to random thoughts I can't control.
I worry about other things while I'm supposed to focus.
I keep humming, doodling or fidgeting instead of doing the task.

subthemes.name: Procrastination patterns
items: I say 'in 5 minutes' and then don't start for an hour.
I do easy things first to avoid hard things.
I keep finding reasons to delay.
I wait until the last minute to do things.
I promise myself I'll start tomorrow, and I don't.
I only work when I'm scared of the deadline.
I avoid homework until someone gets angry.

subthemes.name: Urge management
items: I give in to the urge to check my phone even when I know I shouldn't.
I feel strong urges to get up and do something else.
I can't stop myself from switching tasks.
I have to act on an idea right when I think of it.
I find it very hard to wait when I want something.
I can't resist snacks or games during study time.
I get a 'bored' feeling that makes me need to do something else.

subthemes.name: Task breakdown
items: I don't know how to break a big project into smaller parts.
I try to do everything at once.
My plan is just 'do the homework', with no steps.
I start in the middle of a task without thinking about the beginning.
I struggle to know what to do first, second, third.
I can't guess how long tasks will take.
I run out of time because I planned badly.
I feel overwhelmed by big tasks I haven't broken down.

subthemes.name: Time awareness
items: I lose track of time easily.
I think something will take 10 minutes but it takes an hour.
I don't notice time passing when I'm on my phone.
I'm late for things because I misjudge time.
I don't look at the clock when I should.
I miss deadlines because I forget what day it is.
I start tasks too late in the day.
I feel surprised when time is up.

subthemes.name: Materials & workspace
items: I lose my pencil, book or diary often.
My school bag is messy and I can't find things.
I forget to pack what I need for tomorrow.
My study table is cluttered.
I waste time looking for things I need to study.
I don't remember where I left my homework.
I need to start over because I can't find notes.

subthemes.name: Deadline tracking
items: I forget when homework is due.
I don't write down my test dates.
I remember a deadline only when the teacher mentions it.
I can't tell which task is most important this week.
I miss projects because I don't track them.
I don't look at my planner even when I have one.
I rely on someone else to remind me of dates.

subthemes.name: Confidence in abilities
items: I don't think I'm smart enough for my grade.
I feel most other students understand things faster than me.
I'm scared to try things I think I'll fail at.
I give up on something if I don't understand it quickly.
I feel I can't learn new things like my classmates can.
I think my brain doesn't work the way school expects.
I feel 'slow' compared to friends.
I believe I'm bad at certain subjects for good.

subthemes.name: Asking for help
items: I'm scared to ask my teacher a question in class.
I'd rather stay stuck than ask for help.
I worry others will laugh if I say I don't understand.
I don't tell my parents when I'm struggling.
I don't put my hand up even when I want to.
I pretend to understand when I don't.
I feel it's weak to need help.
I wait for someone to notice I'm stuck, instead of asking.

subthemes.name: Fear of mistakes
items: I feel really bad when I make a mistake.
I'm scared to try answers I'm not sure about.
I don't like being corrected in front of others.
I think making mistakes means I'm bad at something.
I replay mistakes in my head long after.
I'd rather leave an answer blank than get it wrong.
I'm embarrassed to try in front of classmates.

subthemes.name: Academic self-concept
items: I think of myself as 'not a study person'.
I feel I'm 'bad at maths / English / science'.
I decided long ago I'm not good at school.
I believe some kids are 'born smart' and I'm not.
I don't see myself doing well academically ever.
I feel my label at school is 'the one who struggles'.
I don't try my best because I don't believe it will help.

subthemes.name: Interest & curiosity
items: I find my school subjects boring.
I don't feel curious about what I'm learning.
I don't ask questions even when I wonder about things.
Nothing in class really excites me.
I don't read anything outside of textbooks.
I don't look up topics I find interesting on my own.
I just do what I'm told, I don't explore.
I don't feel joy in learning anymore.

subthemes.name: Boredom & disengagement
items: I feel bored for most of the class.
I stare out the window during lessons.
Class feels slow or pointless.
I don't take part in class discussions.
I'm just waiting for the day to end.
I feel disconnected from what the teacher is teaching.
I just go through the motions in class.
I feel my mind is somewhere else during class.

subthemes.name: Reward & recognition
items: I need someone to praise me to keep working.
I only do tasks if there's a reward.
I don't feel good about my work unless someone else says so.
If no one checks my work, I don't try my best.
Grades feel like the only reason to study.
I don't feel proud of myself when I do well.
I need constant 'well done' to keep going.

subthemes.name: Long-term meaning
items: I don't understand why school matters for my future.
I feel what I'm learning isn't useful.
I can't picture how studies connect to my goals.
I don't know what I'm working towards.
School feels like something I have to do, not want to do.
I don't connect lessons to real life.
I don't feel excited about anything I'm learning for the future.

subthemes.name: Response to failure
items: I get upset when I get a question wrong.
A bad mark ruins my whole day.
I feel like a failure after a mistake.
I avoid looking at my mistakes.
I feel angry at myself when I get something wrong.
A mistake makes me want to give up on the subject.
I feel embarrassed to see my low scores.
I throw away or hide work I did badly on.

subthemes.name: Giving up early
items: I stop trying if something is hard.
I say 'I can't do this' before I've really tried.
I give up after one wrong answer.
I quit when things get difficult.
I don't attempt questions I don't know right away.
I don't stay with hard problems long enough.
When I'm stuck, I just stop.
I move to the next task without trying.

subthemes.name: Self-criticism
items: I'm hard on myself when I mess up.
I call myself 'stupid' in my head.
I compare myself to others and feel bad.
I'm meaner to myself than to friends.
I keep replaying what went wrong.
I feel ashamed of my mistakes.
I think one bad result means I'm bad.

subthemes.name: Learning from mistakes
items: I don't look at corrections, I just move on.
I don't understand why I got something wrong.
I make the same mistakes again and again.
I don't ask the teacher to explain mistakes.
I don't practise the parts I got wrong.
I avoid thinking about tests I did badly in.
I don't see mistakes as something to learn from.

subthemes.name: Sleep patterns
items: I sleep less than I should on school nights.
I stay up late on screens.
I feel sleepy during school.
I take ages to fall asleep after lying down.
I sleep at very different times each night.
I only catch up on sleep at weekends.
I wake up tired no matter how long I slept.
I watch videos in bed before sleeping.

subthemes.name: Physical energy & nutrition
items: I skip breakfast on school days.
I eat a lot of junk food.
I feel weak or low-energy during class.
I don't drink enough water.
I get tired quickly during PE or play.
I feel heavy or sluggish after meals.
I don't eat proper meals most days.
I feel tired all the time.

subthemes.name: Screen time balance
items: I spend too many hours on screens every day.
I lose study time to videos, games or chats.
I stare at screens even when I'm not enjoying it.
I use my phone for hours after school.
My eyes feel tired from screens.
I use screens right until bedtime.
I pick up my phone even in the middle of study.

subthemes.name: Rest & downtime
items: I don't take proper breaks between study sessions.
My breaks are just more screens.
I don't get any time outside for play.
I feel I'm either studying or on a screen, nothing else.
I don't relax properly during the day.
I feel like I never fully rest.
My weekends feel busier than weekdays.

subthemes.name: Anxiety before study
items: I feel nervous when I sit down to study.
I feel my stomach tight before homework.
I worry about getting things wrong before I start.
I feel tense before tests even days ahead.
I feel scared opening my maths / science book.
My heart beats fast when teachers announce a test.
I feel panicky when homework is hard.
I feel knots in my chest at exam time.

subthemes.name: Frustration & anger during tasks
items: I get angry when I can't solve a problem.
I slam my books or pen when frustrated.
I cry when work feels too hard.
I snap at my parents when they ask about homework.
I feel like throwing my book across the room sometimes.
I feel like giving up in anger.
I lose my temper quickly when studying.
Frustration takes over before I can think.

subthemes.name: Mood and learning
items: I can't study if I'm in a bad mood.
I feel sad while studying.
I feel irritated by small things in class.
My mood changes a lot during the school day.
I feel low after school most days.
I don't enjoy going to school anymore.
Studying makes me feel heavy and tired.

subthemes.name: Overwhelm
items: I feel like it's all too much at once.
I feel like crying when I see pending work.
My mind feels full of worry I can't name.
I can't focus because I'm feeling too much.
I feel like running away from it all.
I feel scared about everything piling up.
I feel too tired and too stressed at the same time.

subthemes.name: Physical workspace
items: I don't have a quiet place to study at home.
I study where there's too much noise.
I don't have my own desk or chair for study.
My study space is cluttered.
I share my study area with too many people.
The light where I study is not good.
I keep my phone near me when I study.
My study space feels uncomfortable.

subthemes.name: Family support at home
items: My family interrupts me while I study.
I feel no one at home can help me with homework.
My parents are too busy to sit with me.
Nobody checks my timetable or homework.
I get scolded for studying the 'wrong' way.
My family argues about my studies.
My parents don't encourage me enough.
I don't have a routine my family supports.

subthemes.name: Teacher relationships
items: I don't feel comfortable with some of my teachers.
I'm scared to ask my teacher questions.
I feel my teachers don't notice when I'm struggling.
My teachers scold more than they help.
I feel invisible in class.
I don't like most of my teachers.
My teachers don't know what I need.

subthemes.name: Peer learning context
items: I don't have a study buddy or group.
My friends don't study together with me.
I feel lonely doing homework.
My classmates distract me when we work together.
I feel I can't learn from my classmates.
My friends don't take studies seriously.
There's no one at school I can study with.
